text.p: Spain's Telefonica gave a "favourable" reading of a rebalancing of its tariffs to be announced by the Development Ministry, although it did not specify what the changes would entail.

In a note sent to the stock market commission CMNV on Tuesday, Telefonica said the approval of interconnection charges to other operators for using its network and a tariff rebalancing pending publication "represent a great advance in the liberalisation of the telecommunications sector in Spain."
The new tariffs, which follow European Union recommendations, mark the start of a new phase "with the clear objective of continuing improving efficiency and thus maximising shareholder value."
The efficiency improvement would mean reducing costs even more and increasing income via new products and services.
Telefonica said the changes would be announced shortly.
